md.description:
To set up the trigger for new form submissions, follow these steps:

1. Go to the "Dashboard" section.
2. Select the form where you want the trigger to occur.
3. Click on the "Settings" section.
4. Find the "Webhook URL" field and paste above URL there.  
6. Click on "Save".

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Formspark form receives a new submission, delivered via webhook. The event represents one completed form submission and carries the submitted field values as its payload.

nl.\nTo set up the trigger for new form sub:
Om de trigger voor nieuwe formulierinzendingen in te stellen, volg je de volgende stappen:

1. Ga naar de "Dashboard" sectie.
2. Selecteer het formulier waar de trigger plaats moet vinden.
3. Klik op de "Instellingen" sectie.
4. Zoek het "Webhook URL" veld en plak daar boven de URL.  
6. Klik op "Opslaan".

1. Gehen Sie zum Abschnitt "Dashboard".

pt.\nTo set up the trigger for new form sub:
Para configurar o gatilho para novas submissões de formulários, siga estas etapas:

1. Vá para a seção "Painel".
2. Selecione o formulário onde você deseja que o gatilho ocorra.
3. Clique na seção "Configurações".
4. Encontre o campo "URL do Webhook" e cole acima da URL.  
6. Clique em "Salvar".
